description: Retrieve and quote the VERBATIM text of federal Materialien: Federal Council Botschaften, Berichte and Stellungnahmen des Bundesrates, parliamentary committee reports, Erlassentwürfe — and the Vernehmlassung documents: Erläuternde Berichte, Vorlagen, Ergebnisberichte, Stellungnahmen (2,500+ procedures from Fedlex). Each hit is tagged `doc_type`; filter with doc_type, default all. Bundesblatt hits come in `results` (bbl_citation, title, publication_date from Fedlex where available — `publication_date_source` says whether it is Fedlex's date or only the BBl year — page, section, article anchor); Vernehmlassung passages come in `vernehmlassung_results` (or in `results` when doc_type is a Vernehmlassung type), with the whole paragraph `text`, PDF page, procedure title, dates, office and Fedlex ELI link. Use it when starting from a concept rather than an SR/article (get_article_purpose answers 'why does Art. X exist?'). Quote verbatim. No paragraph with every term: ranked OR, flagged `filters_relaxed`.

doc_type.description: OPTIONAL Fedlex document type. botschaft = Botschaft des Bundesrates (Message / Messaggio); bericht_bundesrat = Bericht des Bundesrates; stellungnahme_bundesrat = Stellungnahme des Bundesrates (Avis / Parere); bericht_kommission = Bericht parlamentarische Kommission; erlassentwurf = Erlassentwurf (draft act, 2021+); vorentwurf_erlass = Vorentwurf; vernehmlassung_eroeffnung = Eröffnung des Vernehmlassungsverfahrens. Vernehmlassung documents: erlaeuternder_bericht, vernehmlassungsvorlage, ergebnisbericht, stellungnahmen, synoptische_tabelle, vernehmlassung_diverses. Leave unset to search every type; each hit carries doc_type and Fedlex's doc_type_label in its own language.

language.description: OPTIONAL — only set when the user explicitly limits the search to one language. Leave unset to search the corpus the caller has (currently de only). Setting this without the user asking will hide all non-matching Botschaft passages.

query.description: Search terms. FTS5 syntax supported — use quoted phrases for exact matches ('"Vaterschaftsurlaub"'), Boolean operators ('Klimaschutz AND Kanton'), and prefix queries ('Versicherungs*'). Stopwords are ignored.

year_max.description: Latest publication year of the source Botschaft (inclusive).

year_min.description: Earliest publication year of the source Botschaft (inclusive) — scope legislative history to an era.

name: search_botschaft
title: Search Botschaft
